verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an agent framework and platform rather than a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server for external agents is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence only shows client-side MCP use: the `mcps` field lets CrewAI agents consume MCP tools. Nothing in the pack shows CrewAI exposing its own crews, docs or platform through an official MCP server; external access is documented only via REST API, llms.txt and coding-agent setup prompts.
